table.retrieve:
SELECT saleinvcode = dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode,     
       date = dbo.saleledgermodified.date,   
       invdiscperc = dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc,    
       flatdisc = dbo.saleledgermodified.flatdisc,    
       misccharges = dbo.saleledgermodified.misccharges, 
       invsalestax = dbo.saleledgermodified.salestax,
		 CustRefNo   = dbo.saleledgermodified.CustRefNo,
		 remarks     = dbo.saleledgermodified.Remarks,
		 looseqty = dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty, 
		 packing=case
						when dbo.item.packcode IS Null then space(30) 
						else dbo.itempacking.name
					end,
       itemflatdisc=saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc,
       packqty  = saledetailmodified.packqty,  
       price = dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice,    
       itemdiscperc = dbo.saledetailmodified.discperc,    
		 packunits = dbo.saledetailmodified.packunits,    
		 batch = dbo.saledetailmodified.batch,    
		 expiry = dbo.saledetailmodified.expiry,    
		 salestax  = saledetailmodified.salestax,
	 	 itemname = item.name,
		 datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledgermodified.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledgermodified.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledgermodified.date)))), 
		 Person = dbo.accounts.name,
       patient=(select name from patient where  patientcode=:ai_patientcode),
		 regno = (select regno from patient where  patientcode=:ai_patientcode)

FROM 	 dbo.saleledgermodified, 
		 dbo.saledetailmodified,    
		dbo.item
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
		 dbo.accounts
WHERE  dbo.saleledgermodified.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.patientcode = :ai_patientcode and
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetailmodified.saleinvcode and  
		 dbo.saledetailmodified.icode = item.icode and 
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode
table.sort: patient A, regno A, saleinvcode A, date A, itemname A, batch A, expiry A

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum((((  looseqty   *  price  ) - (itemflatdisc* looseqty))  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ))  *  invdiscperc  * 0.01 for all)

objects.name: c_totaldisc
objects.expression: sum(  flatdisc for all Distinct  saleinvcode  )  +  compute_4

objects.name: c_totalmisccharges
objects.expression: sum( misccharges for all Distinct   saleinvcode  )

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: Round(sum(   c_amount  for all ) + sum(misccharges for all distinct   saleinvcode ) - sum( flatdisc  for all distinct saleinvcode) -   compute_4 , 0)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round(((  looseqty   *  price  )-(itemflatdisc* looseqty))  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ), 2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round (Sum(((  looseqty   *  price  )-( itemflatdisc * looseqty ))  *  ( 1 - (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 2) *  ( 1 - invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)
